verdict.rationale: Docusign ships multiple AI-generated insight features across its data: AI-Assisted Summary and Q&A on agreements, AI-Assisted Review that flags risky language, suggests redlines, and drafts new clauses via chat, and CLM AI that flags non-compliant clauses and suggests approved language, plus AI-based field/document type detection. These are first-party documented product capabilities directly matching the story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of these AI features' quality (community evidence only covers API/reliability, not AI insights), and no detail on underlying model or accuracy benchmarks.
